<a id="editorial-state"></a>

# Editorial State

Editorial state is the content around the flow: index prose, the footer and note blocks. It is stored in the book, not in the output.

Index prose is a one-line description in the book index. The text lives in a block referenced by the node; `prose set` creates or updates that block and `prose clear` removes it.

The index shape is derived: without prose or status it is a list, and prose adds a description column. The per-file contents list never carries prose.

The footer is one region with one block. `region set --kind footer` replaces it; `region clear --kind footer` removes the region and its body.

Note blocks attach to a node or a block. `region notes --target node|block --id <target>` appends a note; `region remove --target ...` removes the whole note region. Note blocks render next to their target.

The status system, the badges and the generated layouts have their own chapters. They are not authored through prose; they are assigned, declared or configured.

Every editorial command is open-only and dry-run aware. The change is atomic and covered by the rollback package, like every other mutation.

```text
pecia prose set --book guide --node <chapter> --prose "A short summary."
pecia region set --book guide --kind footer --body "Footer text."
pecia region notes --book guide --target node --id <chapter> --body "A note."
```
